subject: Linguistics
title: Bilingual Acquisition
description: A short lesson to help you apply Bilingual Acquisition.

hook.text: Bilingual babies hit the same milestones on time—they don't lag behind monolinguals.

buildup.text: Children exposed to two languages from birth separate them early—by age two, their grammars are distinct.

discovery.text: Bilingual children may have smaller vocabularies in each language but a larger total vocabulary.

twist.text: Code-mixing in bilingual children follows adult grammar rules—it's not confusion, it's dual competence.

climax.text: Early bilingualism enhances metalinguistic awareness—understanding that language is a system, not reality.

punchline.text: Two languages from birth—two systems, one agile brain.

quiz.question: Do bilingual babies develop language more slowly?
options: No, they hit milestones on time
Only if the languages are very different
